# Funny Beach Alcudia

> > Premier watersports destination in Mallorca offering jet ski rentals, parasailing, boat tours, and extreme water activities for all ages across Alcudia and surrounding beaches.

Funny Beach Alcudia is a comprehensive watersports operator serving the Mallorca region with locations in Alcudia, Muro, Arenal, and Magaluf. The site specializes in adventure water activities and group bookings through integrated booking systems.
